name: Laser diodes
summary: Small semiconductor lasers from optical drives, pointers, levels and printers.
identify: Tiny brass or metal cans on the moving sled of CD, DVD and Blu-ray drives, and in laser pointers, levels, printers and barcode scanners. DVD lasers are red and Blu-ray violet. Even small ones can blind: never look into the beam or aim it at people or aircraft.
test: Power it only through a current-limiting driver or resistor, starting low, and aim it at a wall. Without current limiting it dies instantly.

decay.note: Lasts. Static and over-current kill them.
